name: Guncade
source:
Guncade is a 1980's arcade lovers dream, if that dream also involves being an arms dealer to grannies, clowns, and other suspicious people. Journey through this visual novel and decide who to cater to and who can buzz off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398950/Guncade/
translation:
Guncade是1980年代街机爱好者的梦想，如果这个梦想还包括成为老奶奶、小丑和其他可疑人士的军火商的话。浏览这部视觉小说，决定迎合谁以及谁可以闲聊。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398950/Guncade/
